eps.d: An encounter with another man sets Bill thinking about her life.
Bill has been offered a lift by a mysterious figure on a motorbike. Ben has had an exhausting day.

eps.t: When the Going Gets Tough, the Tough Go Shopping
eps.d: The Porters have a family barbecue, which makes Jenny decide that she wants to be a vegetarian.
Ben has forgotten to tell Bill her mother is coming. Ben encounters an old flame and receives a proposition.
Bill has decided to take her long deferred driving test. Ben also has a secret.
Ben gets an offer Bill can't refuse, and Rona is forced to question her entire lifestyle.
Bill is still unemployed after losing her job at the bakery. Meanwhile, Ben recruits a new assistant to help with his central heating repair business.
Bill has a new job and two new responsibilities - a dog with wind and an ailing Ben.
Bill faces two new problems: Ben's aggression and the unexpected pregnancy in the Porter household.
Bill faces two new problems: Ben's aggression and the unexpected pregnancy in the Porter household.
Rona has a problem, Bill has an interview and a strange presence stalks the Porter house.
David complains about feeling ill, but Bill is too busy preparing the food for Rona's wedding to pay much attention to him.
David lies seriously ill in hospital, while Rona races to the altar.
The Porters agree reluctantly to spend Christmas with Bill's mother Bette.

eps.t: The Secret Diary of David Porter
eps.d: It is impossible to keep secrets in a family, as David's diary reveals.
When Bill thinks the house next door is being robbed, she sets in motion a chain of events filled with terror, burglary - and radio phone-ins.
Bill discovers that Ben has a serious addiction problem. Meanwhile, Rona pays a visit to her old school reunion in an attempt to drum up interest in the catering business she's set up with Bill.

eps.t: Women on the Edge of a Nervous Breakdown
eps.d: Bill and Rona's first job is disrupted by Mother Nature.
Bill's business faces closure and Ben's business is also in trouble because of a feud.

eps.t: Whoopee, We're All Going to Die
eps.d: The Porters' holiday in Florida looks like ending in disaster when Bill's namesake pursues her across America.
The Porter family and their friend Rona decide to spend a relaxing Christmas with Bette and Auntie Pearl in a hotel in the country.
Bill and Ben demonstrate how not to embarrass your daughter in front of your potential in-laws.
Bill resorts to drastic measures to bring about an evening of culture and sparkling conversation.
A strange ethereal force causes the arrival of a sinister letter at the Porter household.
Confined to bed with flu, Bill has difficulty finding out what is going on downstairs - which is just as well!
Jenny is forced to confide in her father for once. Meanwhile, Bill and Rona encounter some unexpected visitors in Rona's home - snakes!
Bill, Ben and Rona take stock of their lives.
Ben wants to go to France for the Christmas holiday, but after the previous year's mishaps, Bill is determined to stay at home, where nothing disastrous can happen.
The Porters argue about how to spend the lottery jackpot.

eps.t: We'd Like to Know a Little Bit About You for Our Files
eps.d: Bill and Ben are concerned about David's private life.
Disaster strikes when Bill and Ben look after the Grimes' house.
Jenny is worried when her boyfriend's grandmother comes to tea.
What could possibly stop Bill and Ben being on time for David's acting competition?
Ben and David organise a seance, in a paranormal attempt to help Rona keep her house.
In a display of poor judgment, Bill entrusts Ben with buying all the food for Christmas. Ben surprises everyone by not buying a turkey, but by bringing home a live pig instead.
Ben is bored and missing the football season, while Bill and Rona are also feeling listless. Meanwhile, Jenny's boyfriend sets off to buy a ring...
Bill is looking forward to a quiet, relaxing time at home, but fate intervenes.
Bill tells Rona not to heed the dire predictions of Psychic Sadie's latest horoscope. But following a worrying phone call from her eccentric Aunt Belle, she is not so certain.
Bill's not keen to agree to owning a family pet because she thinks she'll end up looking after it. Ben suggests they create an imaginary dog for two weeks - but they end up with three real ones.

eps.t: The Man Who Knew Too Much
eps.d: Ben's disaffection with his age leads him into a vulnerable situation when he applies to join a plumbers' secret society known only as the Brotherhood of the Plunger.

eps.t: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
eps.d: Bill is locked inside a wardrobe wearing only a fur coat. Ben is facing a midlife crisis.
Rona turns up with an abandoned baby, which crawls under the floorboards. Ben finds a novel way of coping when he starts to feel depressed about his age.
Bill, Ben, Rona and David end up as stowaways on a cruise ship after dropping off Ben's sister. Meanwhile, Jenny is stuck at home with Bette and Aunt Pearl, who set about making Christmas dinner.
Tension mounts as Jenny awaits her A-level results. Meanwhile Bill discovers that Ben has swapped the family car for a more sensible one - or so he claims.
Ben's football team need to win the next three Saturday matches and he feels there's only one way to ensure they do - to Bill and Rona's horror.
An ex-boyfriend who has made it big in Hollywood pays Bill an unexpected visit, bringing a serious threat to the future of the entire family.
A box of sample chocolate that Ben brings home leads to an addictive weekend for the Porters.

eps.t: When Did You Last See Your Father?
eps.d: Bill's mum, Bette, makes a shocking confession about her late husband. He wasn't cremated but was, in fact, cryogenically frozen. The company that stored him has gone into liquidation - so now she has to take the freezer home.
An Italian exchange student arrives in the Porter household, causing disruption for everyone - but just who is his mysterious father?
Bill and Ben bid farewell to Jenny. Ben reprimands a van thief, an action that has a number of repercussions for the Porters.
The Porters worry that their tendency towards bizarre situations will jeopardise their aim to foster a child.
The arrival of Bill's mother in the household proves detrimental to Declan's discipline.
Ben is annoyed when Jenny brings her new boyfriend to stay. Bill and Declan have sticky problems.
When Bill and Rona go to France to buy cheap wine, they return with more than expected.
It's Halloween, and Ben learns something disturbing from a long-lost uncle.
After all the panic about what may happen at the millennium, Bill is determined that the night will be a memorable one for all the family.
